name: AI Claim Checker
tagline: Fact-card every AI vendor claim before you repeat it to anyone
description: Give it an AI launch post, a benchmark graphic, or a pricing claim and it returns a dated card ruling on each statement: independently backed, vendor-sourced only, contradicted elsewhere, or unverifiable. Sources are attached, so hype can be checked before it spreads.
author: MichaelGannotti
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
